hints.content:
We are given that the first studio charges only a fixed fee. This means that the first studio charges $\$\green 0$ for each additional class.

The table of values for the second studio shows that for each increase of $\blue{2 \text{ Classes}}$, $\pink{\text{Price}}$ increases by $\$\pink{10}$. The fee the studio charges for each additional class is the ratio of the corresponding differences in $\pink{\text{Price}}$ and $\blue{\text{Classes}}$:

$\qquad\dfrac{\Delta \pink{\text{Price}}}{\Delta \blue{\text{Classes}}}=\dfrac{10}{2}=\green{5}$

This means that the second studio charges $\$\green 5$ for each additional class.

**Since $\green{0}<\green{5}$, the second studio charges more for each additional class.**

Again, the first studio charges only a fixed fee, so $\blue 8$ classes a month at the first studio cost $\$\pink{70}$.

We can extend the table of the second studio according to the rate of change we found to find the value of $\pink{\text{Price}}$ when $\blue{\text{Classes}}$ is $\blue 8$:

Classes | Price
-:|-: 
$5$ | $55$
$+1\downarrow$ | $+5\downarrow$
$6$ | $60$
$+1\downarrow$ | $+5\downarrow$
$7$ | $65$
$+1\downarrow$ | $+5\downarrow$
$8$ | $70$

This means that $\blue 8$ classes a month at the second studio cost $\$\pink{70}$.

**Since $\pink{70}=\pink{70}$, both studios cost the same for $8$ classes a month.**

Let's sum it up:

- The second studio charges more for each additional class.

- Both studios cost the same for $8$ classes a month.

question.content:
Raj wants to take yoga classes. There are two yoga studios that have different membership plans.

The first studio charges a fixed amount of $\$70$ per month, and you can take as many classes as you want for no additional charge.

The second studio charges a smaller initial fee plus an additional fee for each class taken. The monthly price (in dollars) of the second studio as a function of the number of classes taken is given by the following table of values:

$\text{Classes}$ | $\text{Price}$ (dollars)
:-: | :-:
$1$ | $35$
$3$ | $45$
$5$ | $55$

**Which studio charges more for each additional class?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

**Raj wants to take $8$ classes each month. Which studio is cheaper for him?**

[[☃ radio 2]]

choices.content: They both charge the same for each additional class
They both cost the same for $8$ classes a month
